purpose: Pre-demotion review_status for the ES rows the 2026-08-20 variant repass could have touched. The es-variant-repass-*-demote-ids-*.json captures record WHICH rows were demoted and note only that prior status was 'auto-approved or manual-approved' — not which. demote:pool writes no rollback artifact, so that lived solely in the Neon snapshot branches. Extracted so those branches can be deleted without losing rollback fidelity. The TR equivalent is tr-repass-pre-demotion-review-status-2026-08-22.json.
rule: Every ES CLOZE row restores to 'auto-approved' — cloze has NO manual-approved rows at all (0 of 4,464 on the snapshot). For translation and sentence_construction, restore to 'manual-approved' if the id appears below, otherwise 'auto-approved'. Always set demotion_reason = NULL.

manualApprovedThatWereDemoted.note: Verified on prod 2026-08-22: all three are review_status='rejected', demotion_reason='pool-hygiene'. Restoring them as 'auto-approved' would silently discard a human review decision — the concrete reason this extraction was worth doing.
